related: PROP-051 (workspace-sync safety gates — the fail-closed disk-pressure pre-flight that correctly blocked sync 08-05..08-08)
PROP-090 (moved tinker clone /tmp -> ${SESSION}/tinker-clone; the per-session placement class this PROP adds a fallback to)
PROP-084 (clone-hygiene.sh preclean — the /tmp-side hygiene this PROP extends to the fallback path)
PROP-085 (root-FS headroom watchdog — the telemetry sibling; this PROP adds the sessions-FS equivalent)
target: monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md (gate A2), monitor/prompts/dome-mirror.md (disk pre-flight), monitor/prompts/curmudgeon.md, monitor/prompts/curmudgeon-verify.md, monitor/prompts/analyst.md, monitor/prompts/decider*.md, monitor/prompts/tinker.md (clone-target selection), monitor/scripts/clone-hygiene.sh (new 'pick-target' helper), tinker.md PROP-030 pre-flight (sessions_fs_avail_mb metric — already shipped this run)
why_human_needed: All clone-target and gate edits live in monitor/prompts/*.md which are NEVER_PUSH (operator applies). Also Part C (host-level /sessions drain) is entirely outside the sandbox's authority: only the operator/host can reclaim the ~9.1 GB held by dead session dirs.
problem_statement: 6-day pipeline outage 2026-08-02..2026-08-08: the shared scheduled-sandbox /sessions device (nvme1n1, 9.98 GB) reached 100% full (0 MB available; measured again this run: df /sessions = 9464/9980 MB used, avail 0). Every agent whose clone target is ${SESSION}/<agent>-clone sits on that device, so their clones fail with ENOSPC regardless of root-FS headroom. Evidence discriminator: workspace-sync-abort-2026-08-08T14-53-33Z.json records clone_fs_avail_mb=0, sessions_fs_avail_mb=0 but root_fs_avail_mb=2782 — the sandbox had ~2.8 GB free on the root FS (/tmp) the whole time. workspace-sync aborted fail-closed >=4 times (abort sentinels 08-05/08-06/08-07/08-08), dome-mirror >=2 (08-06, 08-08), blocking BOTH sync directions. Agents without disk gates behaved worse: curmudgeon and analyst ran 2026-08-08 ~15:19-15:21Z in improvised degraded-FUSE mode (FUSE-only writes: WIN-002.c5.json review, WIN-021.c6.json review from 08-05, expansion-iss3043-*, proposal-ISS-3043-*, tracker.json/tracker-archive.jsonl appends, status.json analyst fields) — exactly the improvisation class the PROP-051 gates were built to prevent, but those gates only exist in workspace-sync.md and dome-mirror.md. Decider, social, and tinker produced nothing at all 08-03..08-08. Poller empirically validated the escape path on 08-08: its poll note records '/tmp at 95% with 9 stale multi-hour-old clones', it ran clone-hygiene.sh preclean, cloned on the root FS, and pushed successfully. The /sessions accumulation itself is host-level: 5,701 session dirs (ls /sessions | wc -l), each mode 750 owned by per-session uids, unreadable and un-deletable from any other session's uid — in-sandbox cleanup is impossible, and any agent clone leaked into a dead session dir is permanently unreclaimable ballast.
recommendation: Three parts plus telemetry. PART A (prompt edits, operator-applied): add a shared clone-target selection step to every clone-using agent prompt — before cloning, check available MB on the ${SESSION} device (df -m ${SESSION} | awk 'NR==2{print $4}'); if < 700 MB (full clone ~180-480 MB + working headroom), fall back to /tmp/<agent>-clone on the root FS, after running clone-hygiene.sh preclean against BOTH candidate parents. Keep ${SESSION} as the preferred target (session-bounded cleanup remains the right default per PROP-090); /tmp is the pressure-relief valve, already covered by the standing 4h stale-clone empowerment and each agent's EXIT-trap rm -rf. For workspace-sync/dome-mirror specifically, amend gate A2 from 'abort when clone FS lacks space' to 'retarget to /tmp when sessions FS lacks space but root FS has >= 1000 MB; abort only when BOTH lack space'. PART B (gate parity): add the same minimal fail-closed disk-pressure pre-flight (check-then-abort-with-sentinel, plus the Part-A fallback) to curmudgeon.md, curmudgeon-verify.md, analyst.md, decider prompts, social.md — the agents that this outage showed will improvise FUSE-only writes when their clone fails. A one-paragraph 'if clone fails for ANY reason: write abort sentinel to monitor/integrity/, do NOT fall back to FUSE edits' prohibition mirrors workspace-sync's degraded-mode prohibitions. PART C (operator/host, the actual root cause): drain the /sessions device. 5,701 accumulated session dirs hold ~9.1 GB that no sandbox uid can list or delete. Options: host-side purge of session dirs older than N days, a host cron, or a platform-level session-retention setting. Until Part C happens, Part A keeps the pipeline alive but the device stays at 0 MB. PART D (telemetry, ALREADY SHIPPED this run): sessions_fs_avail_mb added to the PROP-030 queue-history metrics row (monitor/tinker/queue-history.jsonl row ts=2026-08-08T18:16:37Z carries the first sample, value 0). Proposed threshold: sessions_fs_avail_mb < 700 => moderate finding; < 100 => major + operator-escalation summary line.

verification_pattern.pattern: After Part A/B application: grep -l 'disk-pressure' monitor/prompts/curmudgeon.md monitor/prompts/analyst.md monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md monitor/prompts/dome-mirror.md returns all four; next disk-pressure event produces EITHER successful /tmp-fallback clones (agents keep committing) OR abort sentinels from every blocked agent (no FUSE-only improvised artifacts). Detection canary: tinker queue-history rows carry sessions_fs_avail_mb; a fresh multi-day gap in analyst/curmudgeon/decider commits while sessions_fs_avail_mb=0 means Part A was not applied or did not work.
verification_pattern.why_not_grade_A: Prompt-behavior change under a condition (disk pressure) that cannot be safely induced on demand; verification is observational at the next natural occurrence.

rollback: Prompt edits are additive paragraphs — remove them to restore prior behavior. The /tmp fallback inherits existing hygiene (preclean + EXIT trap + 4h empowerment), so the worst-case regression is the pre-PROP-090 status quo (clones on /tmp), which the pipeline ran on for weeks.
tradeoffs: Clones on /tmp survive session end until the 4h empowerment or another agent's preclean sweeps them — poller's 08-08 observation of 9 stale multi-hour clones at /tmp 95% shows the fallback path needs the preclean step to be non-optional, not that the fallback is wrong.

Retargeting workspace-sync/dome-mirror to /tmp weakens PROP-090's session-bounded-leak property for exactly the runs that use the fallback; acceptable because the alternative demonstrated this week is a total sync outage.
Part B adds ~10-15 lines to five prompts (context cost) but closes the improvised-degraded-FUSE class that produced the 2026-05-07/08 wins.json breakage precedent.
estimated_impact: Converts a total multi-agent outage (6 days this occurrence) into zero-downtime degradation whenever the /sessions device fills again — which it will, since the accumulation mechanism (dead session dirs, unreclaimable in-sandbox) is still active until Part C. Also closes the no-gate improvisation gap on 5 agent prompts.
operator_actions_summary: 1. HOST-LEVEL (urgent, root cause): drain /sessions — 5,701 dead session dirs, ~9.1 GB, device at 0 MB available. No in-sandbox workaround exists.
2. Apply Part A/B prompt edits (NEVER_PUSH surfaces; exact edit text in recommendation).
3. Ratify the Part D telemetry thresholds (tinker.md pre-flight prose; tinker can self-apply on approval).
